{07 00 00}People think bugs are
gross, but I think that's
just because of ignorance.
Once you get to know them,{07 14 00}
bugs have their own kind
of cuteness, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 13 00}I could just drown in those
bottomless, multifaceted
eyes, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}You know what we should do,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}?{01 00 00 0f 00} We should have
a contest, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{04 1a 00}
first: you or me!

{07 00 00}It's one of the sad facts
of adult life that people
lose interest in insects.
{07 14 00}Being in touch with insects
is like being in touch with
your inner child.
You're always young at
heart when you've got a
bug in your pants!
